default.desc: Populated: program, name, mobile filled, both notices loaded and ticked, Enrol enabled

dark.desc: Populated, dark (estimated tokens; live app is light only)

empty.desc: Blank form, notices loaded, Enrol disabled

error.desc: Exact reference s07b: blank form, notices still loading, server error banner, Enrol disabled

duplicate.desc: Filled form, duplicate-mobile error, Enrol disabled

zero.desc: No programs configured: Program shows empty list, Enrol disabled

focus-name.desc: Program chosen, Name focused and empty (cursor target for typing)

consent-ticked.desc: Filled form, consents unticked then service ticked (tick target)

busy.desc: Submitting: Enrol shows Enrolling..., fields locked
